3. Experiments

3.1 CIFAR-100 Benchmark

We evaluate on CIFAR-100, which consists of 60,000 32×32 color images in 100
fine-grained classes, with 500 training and 100 test images per class. Images
are normalized with per-channel mean and standard deviation.

3.2 Data Augmentation and Training

During training we apply random horizontal flip (p=0.5) and random crop with
4-pixel padding. We train a Wide ResNet-28-10 for 200 epochs using SGD with
Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, and batch size 128. Learning rate
starts at 0.1 and follows a cosine schedule. We report top-1 accuracy.
